name: Fish Cleaner
description: A saw on a fish line: cleans the big fish, passes everything else on.

pages.title: Fish Cleaner
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Put it in a fish line: fish go in the back, sides or top, and come out the front.
- A fish of **3 kg or more** is cut up like on the [#](2E5AAC)[Cleaning Table](entry://fishing/cleaning)[#]().
- Everything else passes through **untouched**.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() The saw needs [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]().
A knife over an andesite casing between two shafts, over a Cleaning Table.

pages.title: Which fish it cleans
pages.text:
Only fish too big to use whole: 3 kg or more, the ones no furnace, smoker, campfire or fan will cook. Their tooltip says so.\
\
Smaller fish, stacked catches and anything that isn't a fish go straight out the front as they came, catch data and all, even with the shaft stopped.

pages.title: Cutting
pages.text:
A big fish takes the same strokes as on the table: five at 3 kg, sixteen at 50 kg. At 32 [#](7A3C9A)[RPM](entry://glossary/rpm)[#]() the saw makes two strokes a second; faster shafts cut faster. It gives the table's parts: fillets, steaks, roe, bones, scraps, shark skin.\
\
It costs 4 SU per RPM, like Create's saw. See [#](2E5AAC)[Stress](entry://create_basics/stress)[#]().

pages.title: Hooking it up
pages.text:
It faces away from you when placed, with a shaft through it side to side.\
\
**In:** a belt ending at its back or side, a chute or hopper above, a funnel.\
**Out:** a belt, depot, chute or chest in front, else the ground. Funnels and hoppers can pull from it too. See [#](2E5AAC)[Moving Items](entry://create_basics/item_logistics)[#]().

It holds one big fish at a time and starts the next only when the last one's parts have left, so a blocked output stops the line instead of losing anything. Small fish queued behind a big one wait their turn.\
\
An empty hand takes out whatever is inside, uncut. Goggles show the fish and the strokes done.
